# canton_user (Data Source)

Looks up an existing user on a Canton participant node by their user ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "canton_user" "treasury_service" {
  user_id = "treasury-service"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `user_id` (String) The user ID to look up.

### Read-Only

- `primary_party` (String) The primary party for the user.
